answer: One signed key is cheap; a single-tide crane reservation is not. The applicant locks 18.9 POA and draws tally TL-306 for crane C-7 at wharf WH-22. In 27 minutes they sling a 4.80 kg juniper crate (lot JP-4419) onto hook HK-8, log resin viscosity 12.6 cP at 18C, and seat jade gauge JG-31 (500.00 g) on the same cell. Reviewers recompute SHA-256(tally||hook||mass_bin||addr) and require an 8-minute gap from any earlier weigh-in. A reused lot, short gap, or mass off by over 14 g burns 6.8 POA and bars the key for six epochs; 8.5 POA vests only after a later tally whose lot and hook both change.
